summary: Frontend-only testing of FR/EN bilingual toggle implementation (React Context API). Verified language toggle button, FR default + localStorage persistence, Home/Send/Tracking/Login/Backoffice render and translate correctly, and CRITICAL Italy hub address (Simo Patrice / Via Roma 35 / 26866 Lodi / +39 3287091255) remains intact in BOTH FR and EN on both directions (EU_TO_CM and CM_TO_EU). admin/admin123 login redirects to /backoffice without Context crashes.

integration_issues.issue: Hardcoded French strings 'Dépôt:' and 'Arrivée:' in the parcel management table do not switch to English when language is toggled to EN (still showing FR). Likely not using t() helper for these labels.
Welcome toast 'Bienvenue Administrateur' after login is hardcoded in French and does not translate when language is EN.

action_items: Wrap 'Dépôt:' and 'Arrivée:' labels in Backoffice parcels table with t() (add translation keys e.g., label_depot, label_arrival).
Translate the post-login welcome toast 'Bienvenue Administrateur' using t() (add keys e.g., welcome_admin).
Optional: 'dashboard' translation key exists in translations.js but isn't rendered as a visible heading on Backoffice. Either render it as a page title or remove the unused key.
critical_code_review_comments: LanguageContext implementation is clean and correct: state initialized from localStorage with 'fr' default, useEffect persists changes, toggleLanguage swaps fr<->en. No re-render or crash issues observed.
LanguageProvider correctly wraps BrowserRouter in App.js so all routes consume the context.

Send.jsx FIXED_ITALY_ADDRESS is an in-component constant rendered directly (not via t()), which is the correct approach - the hub address is a real-world physical address that must never be translated. Verified intact.
translations.js: 'dashboard' key defined but not consumed in Backoffice page (dead key). Minor cleanup item.
Backoffice has multiple hardcoded FR strings ('Dépôt:', 'Arrivée:', toast 'Bienvenue Administrateur') that bypass the i18n layer - inconsistent coverage.
test_credentials: admin / admin123 (verified working). NOTE: /app/memory/test_credentials.md does NOT exist.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing 20 parcels visible on backoffice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bilingual FR/EN toggle is functionally working end-to-end. Default is FR, persists via localStorage 'lang'. Toggle button data-testid='language-toggle-button' present in Header on all pages. Hardcoded Italy hub address in Send.jsx is verified intact in both FR and EN, both directions. Only remaining gaps are 2 hardcoded French strings in Backoffice ('Dépôt:'/'Arrivée:' table labels and login welcome toast 'Bienvenue Administrateur') that should be routed through t(). No Context API crashes/blank screens observed. Login admin/admin123 -> /backoffice works.
rca_of_the_issue: Not a bug session - feature verification. Translation gaps in Backoffice are due to certain strings being hardcoded directly in JSX rather than passed through the useLanguage().t() helper. Fix: add translation keys (label_depot, label_arrival, welcome_admin) to /app/frontend/src/translations.js and replace literal strings in Backoffice.jsx with t('...') calls.
